## Enlist

Coby wanted to be a Marine so badly he swabbed Alvida's decks for two years first. You can skip that part.

Join the Marines and reach the rank of Seaman.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Join the Marines](f_marines.md#q-7e22c74144d331d5)

**Tasks**

- Rank: Seaman

**Rewards**

- Doriki +120, Belly +5,000, Loyalty +1

## Patrol of the 153rd

Shells Town lost its tyrant and needed real Marines. Pirates and bandits do not arrest themselves.

Defeat twenty pirates and ten bandits.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Enlist](f_marines.md#q-11d44ba0247d36f3)

**Tasks**

- Defeat 20 pirates
- Defeat 10 bandits

**Rewards**

- Doriki +210, Belly +8,000, Loyalty +2

## Lieutenant

A lieutenant can call a squad to their side. Use it.

Reach the rank of Lieutenant, defeat three pirate captains and belong to a crew. Crews are open to every faction.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Patrol of the 153rd](f_marines.md#q-56b2a2df71ca62b4)

**Tasks**

- Rank: Lieutenant
- Belong to a crew (/crew create &lt;name&gt;, or accept an invite)

**Rewards**

- Doriki +210, Belly +8,500, Loyalty +2

<a id="q-3f1b68783ddd2bad"></a>

## Commander

Commanders lead whole bases, and the World Government recruits its agents from among them.

Reach the rank of Commander. A Cipher Pol Recruitment Officer in a Marine base can now offer you a place in the World Government.

**Tasks**

- Rank: Commander

**Rewards**

- Doriki +420, Belly +8,500, Loyalty +2

## Impel Down's Jailer

Magellan never lost a prisoner until the day he lost over two hundred.

Reach the rank of Captain and defeat twenty-five hostiles in Impel Down (through a Gate of Justice, in the Calm Belts).

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Justice Will Prevail](f_marines.md#q-1dc536abf6dd93c5)

**Tasks**

- Rank: Captain
- Defeat 25 hostiles in Impel Down

**Rewards**

## Buster Call

A Buster Call takes a golden Den Den Mushi and someone senior enough to use it. Ohara burned for less.

Reach the rank of Commodore, defeat thirty pirates or revolutionaries on Enies Lobby and hold an island for your crew. Any crew can take islands through conquest.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Impel Down's Jailer](f_marines.md#q-1c7eecc835362fc1)

**Tasks**

- Rank: Commodore
- Defeat 30 pirates or revolutionaries on Enies Lobby
- Own 1 island at once (island conquest)

**Rewards**

- Doriki +600, Belly +24,500, +1 Training Points (your style), Loyalty +3

## Admiral

Akainu, Kizaru and Aokiji could each sink a fleet alone.

Reach the rank of Admiral and defeat three players with a bounty of at least 30,000,000.

Reward: one of the Admirals' fruits while nobody has it, or a Golden Box (/fruitreward). Taking a fruit here rules out the Fleet Admiral's fruit.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Vice Admiral](f_marines.md#q-141b98d1ece68370)

**Tasks**

- Rank: Admiral
- Defeat 3 players with a bounty of 30,000,000+

**Rewards**

- Doriki +540, Belly +80,000, Haki +5 Busoshoku / +5 Kenbunshoku, +1 Training Points (your style), Loyalty +3
- Choose an Admiral's fruit: Hie, Pika, Mori or Zushi, or a Golden Box

<a id="q-4799c457e752dd9d"></a>

## Fleet Admiral

Sengoku the Buddha led the Navy through the Summit War and resigned soon after.

Rank: Fleet Admiral and own 1 island in the New World at once (island conquest).

Reward: Magu Magu no Mi or Hito Hito no Mi, Model: Daibutsu while nobody has it, or a Golden Box (/fruitreward). Not for one who took an Admiral's fruit: a Golden Box still is.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Admiral](f_marines.md#q-4181facaa2df8c05)

**Tasks**

- Rank: Fleet Admiral
- Own 1 island in the New World at once (island conquest)

**Rewards**

- Doriki +750, Belly +250,000, Haki +5 Busoshoku / +5 Kenbunshoku, +2 Training Points (your style), Fleet Admiral's Hat
- Choose a Fleet Admiral's fruit: Magu or Daibutsu, or a Golden Box
